GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Retrieves the most relevant case study excerpt for an account based on its industry, to use as a proof point in sales outreach.

templateVersions.content: ### INSTRUCTIONS 1. The account's industry is provided below, along with any additional context about the account's situation. 2. Search the CASE STUDIES section to find the most relevant proof point, considering both the industry and any additional context provided. 3. If a relevant case study is found, summarize it in 2-3 sentences as a proof point for sales outreach. 4. If no relevant case study is found, state that clearly rather than inventing one. ### INDUSTRY: {!$Input:industry} ### ADDITIONAL CONTEXT: {!$Input:additional_context} ### CASE STUDIES: {!$EinsteinSearch:Case_Studies_Retriever_1Cx_Be7542ff395.results} ### Response:

templateDataProviders.description: Retrieves relevant case study content (chunked case studies covering electronics, biotech, manufacturing/logistics, and hospitality backup power) to ground personalized outreach with real proof points, matched by industry relevance.
templateDataProviders.label: Case_Studies_Retriever
